description: API specification for Firewall NAT ALG services including listing, retrieving, and setting configurations for NAT ALGs within a network system.

methods.name: Services.Local.Firewall.NAT.ALGs.List
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Firewall NAT ALGs with support for pagination and error handling.

methods.name: Services.Local.Firewall.NAT.ALGs.{ALGId}.Get
methods.description: Retrieves the status and configuration parameters for a specific Firewall NAT ALG identified by ALGId.

methods.name: Services.Local.Firewall.NAT.ALGs.{ALGId}.Set
methods.description: Modifies the status and configuration parameters of a specified Firewall NAT ALG identified by ALGId.
